proposed_widenings.name: UseCountCap — unlimited
proposed_widenings.justification: Fast Hands has no usage limit. The only UseCountCap variants are 'fixed' and 'threshold_tiers'. An 'unlimited' (no-cost) variant is needed for features that fire freely on every turn.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Bonus Action, you can do one of the following. (No 'once per rest' or use-count qualifier anywhere in the feature text.)

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationMechanics — multi-effect choice compositor
proposed_widenings.justification: ClassFeatureActivationMechanics has a single 'effect' field. Fast Hands offers a player-chosen menu of two distinct sub-effects on each use. No choice/either-or compositor exists on ClassFeatureEffect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can do one of the following. [Sleight of Hand.] ... [Use an Object.] ...

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect — ability_check
proposed_widenings.justification: The Sleight of Hand option's core mechanic is 'make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check'. The v4 atom 'ability_check' exists but there is no ClassFeatureEffect variant that maps to it. A new variant like { kind: 'ability_check'; skill: string; purpose: string } is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check to pick a lock or disarm a trap with Thieves' Tools or to pick a pocket.

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect — grant_standard_action_as_bonus_action
proposed_widenings.justification: The Use an Object option lets the rogue take the Utilize or Magic action using their Bonus Action. This is fundamentally different from 'grant_extra_action' (which is an additional full action). A new variant is needed to model 'redirect bonus action to take one of these standard action kinds'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Take the Utilize action, or take the Magic action to use a magic item that requires that action.

notes: Four gaps block honest encoding: (1) no unlimited UseCountCap, (2) no choice compositor on ClassFeatureActivationMechanics, (3) no ability_check ClassFeatureEffect variant, (4) no 'standard action via bonus action' ClassFeatureEffect variant. All gaps are new variants of existing surface types — v4 atoms 'ability_check' and 'bonus_action_quota' already cover the underlying mechanics. Classification is surface_widening, not atom_widening, because the v4 taxonomy contains all required atoms. No dhall/json/trace produced.
